# No Fluff Cruising

> Expert cruise tips, ship reviews and ship tours from Matthew and Marlee, a cruising family of three with more than 40 cruises across every major cruise line. No line loyalty, no filler.

Every factual claim on this site traces to a named source with a date. Tier 1 sources are the cruise line's own published material (benefit grids, press releases, earnings releases). Tier 2 sources are established cruise-news outlets. Where a figure we previously used turns out to be stale, we say so on the page rather than quietly changing it. Pages carry the date they were last checked.

## Sections
- [Ship reviews](https://nofluffcruising.com/watch/): written companions to each video, with the full sourcing behind every claim
- [Guides](https://nofluffcruising.com/guides/): evergreen cruise guides, answer-first
- [News](https://nofluffcruising.com/news/): cruise line announcements and itinerary changes
- [Ship database](https://nofluffcruising.com/ships/): specs, verdicts and coverage for every ship we cover
- [How we source](https://nofluffcruising.com/sources/): the editorial standard behind every page
